events.title: US Treasury Doubles Long-End Buyback Intervention
events.description: Treasury Secretary Bessent announced doubling of long-term debt buybacks from $2B to $4B+, targeting 10-30 year Treasuries. 30-year yields hit 5.3%, highest since 2007. Effectively verbal intervention + direct market operation.

events.title: Global Bond Sell-Off: 30Y Yields Highest Since Financial Crisis
events.description: 30-year US Treasury yields rose to 5.3% (highest since 2007). French borrowing costs highest since 2008. German yields at 2011 levels. Japan, Canada also at decade highs. Global sovereign bond rout.

events.title: Strait of Hormuz Crisis: Day 173 of Closure
events.description: Strait of Hormuz effectively closed to commercial shipping as of Aug 20. Only 1 ship transited Aug 16 vs 73/day normal. Brent at $92.93. IEA calls it largest supply disruption on record. Oil stockpiles being drawn down globally.

events.title: Iran War: Iran Threatens New Offensive, US Rules Out Ceasefire Extension
events.description: Iran threatens new offensive in Strait of Hormuz if diplomacy with US fails. US rules out extending ceasefire deal. Continued exchange of strikes between US and Iran. 2026 Iran war ongoing with collapsed ceasefire.

events.title: Ebola Epidemic: Fastest-Growing Outbreak on Record, WHO PHEIC
events.description: 2026 Ebola epidemic caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV). 5,208 confirmed cases, 2,476 deaths as of Aug 18. WHO declared Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. Existing treatments certified for different species.

events.title: Japan Yen Crisis: US-Japan Intervention, BOJ at 1%
events.description: Yen slide to three-decade low triggered rare US-Japan intervention. Yen approaching 160 level. BOJ kept rate at 1% (8-1 vote, one dissent for hike to 1.25%). Intervention may signal willingness to raise rates sooner. Weekly loss prompts bets for another intervention.

events.title: China Credit Contraction: New Yuan Loans Plunge to -340B
events.description: China's new yuan loans fell sharply to -340B yuan in July (from 1.61T in June). Property market in 5-year downward spiral with values continuing to plummet. Bloomberg reports households in financial distress forced to sell. Developers drowning in debt.

events.title: UK Gilts Disproportionately Exposed to Global Bond Sell-Off
events.description: UK 10Y gilt yield at 5.06%. Markets swung from pricing cuts to pricing hikes in months. Central bank forced to tighten into slowing economy alongside government with almost no fiscal headroom. Combination punishing gilt holders.
